review: EN/HI written 13 Oct 2026, shown to the founder in the Group A screenshots

lines.text: Number pictures turn numbers that are hard to remember into pictures you can see.
Every digit has a sound. 0 is s, 1 is t or d, 2 is n, 3 is m, and 4 is r.
5 is l, 6 is j, ch or sh, 7 is k or g, 8 is f or v, and 9 is p or b.
Two digits make a word from their sounds. 4 and 7 — r and k — a raccoon. 1 and 9 — t and p — a tap.
Vowels don't count, and only the first two sounds matter. You learn one hundred pictures, ten at a time.
Now the number 4719. Split it into pairs: 47 and 19 — a raccoon and a tap.
Make one funny scene: a raccoon washing its paws under a tap, splashing everywhere. Read it back: raccoon, tap — 4 7 1 9.
Start with the first ten pictures, 00 to 09.
